stories.title: More than 230,000 people in Wales now living with diabetes
stories.summary: The number of people living with diabetes in Wales is rising faster than health officials had predicted. stories.title: Flintshire road casualties fall to decade low, official figures show
stories.summary: The number of people hurt on Flintshire’s roads has fallen to its lowest level in at least a decade, but the number killed or seriously injured has barely changed. stories.title: No trains on North Wales line for a weekend in June as Flint flood work begins
stories.summary: No trains will run between Chester and Llandudno Junction for a weekend in June while engineers carry out flood-prevention work at Flint.
